source:
@@U01141@@
Here's a small casket I picked up for you— rather weighty, I'd say— just don’t ask where. Put it there in the clothespress. She'll see it and go out of her mind with joy. I've put in certain trinkets that would win a woman of quite another stamp. But, then, a girl’s a girl, and a game is always a game.

@@U01143@@
Should I? I don’t know—

@@U01145@@
Now what’s the trouble? Or perhaps you mean to keep it yourself? In which case, I advise Your Greediness not to waste the lovely light of day, not to mention my time. Oh, I do hope you're not a miser. I rack my brains, I work my fingers to the bone—

@@U01146@@
(He places the casket in the clothespress and locks it again.)

@@U01147@@
All right, let’s go! Now!— all for the sake of winning this sweet young thing to bend to your every wish; and you stand there gloomy faced as if you'd just entered the lecture hall and seen there in all their drab reality Physics and Metaphysics staring you in the face! Let’s go!

@@U01148@@
(Exeunt.)

@@U01150@@
(Enters with a lamp.)

@@U01151@@
How close and stuffy it is in here.
translation:
@@U01141@@
这是我为你挑选的一个小棺材——我想说相当重——只是不要问在哪里。把它放在熨衣机里。她会看到它并欣喜若狂。我放了一些小饰品，这些小饰品可以赢得一个完全不同的女人的青睐。但是，女孩就是女孩，游戏始终是游戏。

@@U01143@@
我应该吗？我不知道——

@@U01145@@
现在有什么麻烦吗？或者也许您想自己保留它？既然如此，我奉劝贪婪之人不要浪费美好的阳光，更别说浪费我的时间了。哦，我真希望你不是一个守财奴。我绞尽脑汁，绞尽脑汁——

@@U01146@@
（他把棺材放进熨衣机里，然后又锁上。）

@@U01147@@
好吧，我们走吧！现在！——一切都是为了赢得这个可爱的年轻人屈服于你的每一个愿望；你站在那里，脸色阴沉，就好像你刚刚进入演讲厅，看到那里所有单调的现实物理和形而上学正盯着你的脸！我们走吧！

@@U01148@@
（下场。）

@@U01150@@
（提着灯进来。）

@@U01151@@
这里是多么的封闭和闷热啊。
